note: Both sets cover essentially the same claims with accurate values and supporting quotes. Set A adds an unsupported condition to the rated generator speed claim (tagging 1173.7 rpm with 'Region 3', which the page never states), while Set B states it correctly but repeats the Region 3 torque relationship twice under two condition phrasings. Set B therefore has no misread or misbound claims, only a duplication, making it slightly better.
remarks: Both sets omit the stated purposes of the control regions (Region 1 accelerates the rotor for start-up, Region 2 optimizes power capture at constant optimal tip-speed ratio, Region 1½ limits the operational speed range, Region 2½ limits tip speed/noise at rated power) and the filter's phase-lag drawback; these are important facts on the page that neither extraction captured. The 'chosen filter | pass band frequency response | flat' claim in both sets is only indirectly supported (the quote describes the Butterworth filter, with 'like the chosen filter' as the link).
